title: A Atlas for the Letter
author: Casper Eriksen
blurb: Quentin Vane, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
